name: Emergence of Classes: which regime comes first
description: Poza et al. 2011's Figs. 4–5: which regime a random start reaches first — equity (1) or fractiousness (2); the mean minus 1 is the share of runs fractious first. Measured (release, seeds 1–20, 3000 periods, recorded 2026-09-25): under AEY's rule every run reaches equity first at every size (N = 10, 20, 50, 100, m = 10, ε = 0.2); under the mode rule 55–60 % reach the fractious state first.
